discounts.description: The longer the stay, the cheaper the nights: from a number of nights, a percentage off the nights (not the cleaning fee). The highest tier a stay reaches applies. Guests see the tiers next to the price.

cookies.owner: Only the owner's sign-in and the owner's own pages use a few cookies, all strictly necessary: to keep you signed in, to protect the sign-in, and to remember settings you chose yourself.

cookies.why: Cookies that are strictly necessary for a service you asked for need no consent (§ 25(2) no. 2 TTDSG, Art. 5(3) ePrivacy Directive); that is why this site shows no cookie banner. The second name is used on the owner's local network, without https.
